results.description:
要想富，先修路
自从中老铁路投入运营后，到今天也有几年了，老挝获得巨大收益，就连泰国越南柬埔寨周边的农业产品也大量运到老挝万象火车站，再运到中国来。最显著的变化就是泰国金枕榴莲，中国超市、水果店的榴莲明显降价了。希望越南抓紧联通，越南的荔枝、榴莲、红毛丹、山竹更多！

results.title: The existing line into Haiphong is still meter gauge.

results.title: China is that expansionist.
results.description: China is that expansionist. Just think of the 9 dash line grabbing approximately 90% of the SCS. The line loops hundreds of miles away from mainland China, cutting directly into the internationally recognised EEZs of Vietnam, the Philippines, Malaysia, Brunei, and Indonesia.
